newsitem.title: USA: ITT Educational Q1 net up on student, margin gains.
newsitem.headline: ITT Educational Q1 net up on student, margin gains.

text.p: ITT Educational Services Inc said Thursday a surge in student enrollment and higher margins helped earnings in the first quarter improve on year-ago results.

The company, which operates a private college system offering technology-based study programs, said net income in the period ended March 31 totaled $6.2 million, or $0.23 a share, compared to $4.8 million, or $0.18 a share, last year.
Sales in the period rose to $64.5 million from $57.1 million in the same quarter of 1996.
ITT Educational Services stock closed up 1/8 Thursday at 21-1/8.
